targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'ptr' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS ptr, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'bitfield' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS bitfield, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'float' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS float, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'switch' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS switch, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'struct_byval' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS struct_byval, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fnptr' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fnptr, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'int' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS int, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'varargs' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS varargs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'longlong' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS longlong, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'signed' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS signed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'combo' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS combo, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'combo_num' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS combo_num, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fp_deep' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fp_deep, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fp_round' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fp_round, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'volatile' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS volatile, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'agg_deep' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS agg_deep FROM runs r LEFT JOIN correctness c ON c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.oracle = 'olevels' GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'ptr' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS ptr, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'bitfield' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS bitfield, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'float' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS float, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'switch' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS switch, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'struct_byval' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS struct_byval, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fnptr' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fnptr, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'int' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS int, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'varargs' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS varargs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'longlong' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS longlong, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'signed' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS signed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'combo' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS combo, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'combo_num' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS combo_num, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fp_deep' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fp_deep, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'fp_round' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS fp_round, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'volatile' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS volatile, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.profile = 'agg_deep' THEN c.divergent_count END), 0) AS agg_deep FROM runs r LEFT JOIN correctness c ON c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.oracle = 'olevels' GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, COALESCE(SUM(c.divergent_count), 0) AS total FROM runs r LEFT JOIN correctness c ON c.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, COALESCE(SUM(c.divergent_count), 0) AS total FROM runs r LEFT JOIN correctness c ON c.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Code size vs GCC (tcc/gcc ratio, <total>) by opt
panels.description: Total tcc/gcc instruction-count ratio over the whole corpus, one line per opt level (both compilers built at that level). Lower = closer to GCC.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o0' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o0, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o1' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o1, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o2' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN codesize_rollup cr ON cr.run_id = r.run_id AND cr.suite = '<total>' GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o0' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o0, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o1' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o1, MAX(CASE WHEN cr.opt = 'o2' THEN cr.ratio END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN codesize_rollup cr ON cr.run_id = r.run_id AND cr.suite = '<total>' GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Compile time (code-size corpus) by opt
panels.description: Wall time to compile the code-size corpus at each TCC opt level.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o0' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o0, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o1' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o1, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o2' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN compile_time ct ON ct.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o0' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o0, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o1' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o1, MAX(CASE WHEN ct.scope = 'codesize_corpus_o2' THEN ct.seconds END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN compile_time ct ON ct.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: RP2350 cycles/iter ratio vs GCC by opt
panels.description: Average per-benchmark TCC/GCC cycles_per_iter ratio on RP2350, one line per opt level. Lower is better; 1.0 matches GCC.

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o0' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o0, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o1' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o1, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o2' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN perf t ON t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.compiler IN ('TCC', 'TCC-O0', 'TCC-O1', 'TCC-O2') LEFT JOIN perf g ON g.run_id = t.run_id AND g.benchmark = t.benchmark AND g.opt_level = t.opt_level AND g.compiler IN ('GCC', 'GCC-O0', 'GCC-O1', 'GCC-O2') GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_ts AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o0' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o0, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o1' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o1, AVG(CASE WHEN t.opt_level = 'o2' THEN t.cycles_per_iter / NULLIF(g.cycles_per_iter, 0) END) AS o2 FROM runs r LEFT JOIN perf t ON t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.compiler IN ('TCC', 'TCC-O0', 'TCC-O1', 'TCC-O2') LEFT JOIN perf g ON g.run_id = t.run_id AND g.benchmark = t.benchmark AND g.opt_level = t.opt_level AND g.compiler IN ('GCC', 'GCC-O0', 'GCC-O1', 'GCC-O2') GROUP BY r.run_id ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT r.commit_sha AS commit, r.subject AS subject, c.profile, c.oracle, c.divergent_count AS now, p.divergent_count AS parent, (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) AS delta FROM correctness c JOIN runs r USING(run_id) JOIN runs rp ON rp.commit_sha = r.parent_sha AND rp.host = r.host JOIN correctness p ON p.run_id = rp.run_id AND p.profile = c.profile AND p.oracle = c.oracle WHERE (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) > 0 ORDER BY delta DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.commit_sha AS commit, r.subject AS subject, c.profile, c.oracle, c.divergent_count AS now, p.divergent_count AS parent, (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) AS delta FROM correctness c JOIN runs r USING(run_id) JOIN runs rp ON rp.commit_sha = r.parent_sha AND rp.host = r.host JOIN correctness p ON p.run_id = rp.run_id AND p.profile = c.profile AND p.oracle = c.oracle WHERE (c.divergent_count - p.divergent_count) > 0 ORDER BY delta DESC

panels.title: Code size by suite (latest commit, -O2)
panels.description: Suite-level summary only. File/function drilldown lives in the standalone codesize detail server.

targets.queryText: SELECT cr.suite, cr.func_count, cr.tcc_size, cr.gcc_size, cr.ratio FROM codesize_rollup cr WHERE cr.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND cr.opt = 'o2' AND cr.suite <> '<total>' ORDER BY cr.ratio DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT cr.suite, cr.func_count, cr.tcc_size, cr.gcc_size, cr.ratio FROM codesize_rollup cr WHERE cr.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY commit_ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND cr.opt = 'o2' AND cr.suite <> '<total>' ORDER BY cr.ratio DESC
